bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 100 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 8.1% on Oct 22 to $507.93, trading between $502.60 and $529.98 on volume 1.4 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($532.4) and 10-day ($560.3) and the rising 30-day ($582.4) and 100-day ($526.7), but above the rising 200-day ($400.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($577.04), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: AMD 10月22日下跌 8.1%，收于 $507.93，盘中区间 $502.60–529.98，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$532.4）和 10 日均线（$560.3）、上行的 30 日均线（$582.4）下方，并跌破上行的 100 日均线（$526.7），但仍在上行的 200 日均线（$400.6）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$577.04），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The drop broke the $524.6–526.7 support (Oct 20 low, 100-day average), now resistance; the low stopped above the $495–498 late-June and early-July lows. Resistance is $526.7–530, then $548 (Oct 20 high) and $560 (10-day). Support is $495–498, then $460 (Jul 17 low) and $440.5 (Sep 3 low). A close back above $530 would target $548; a close below $495 would open $460.
read.zh: 股价跌破 $524.6–526.7 支撑（10月20日低点、100 日均线），该区域转为阻力；盘中低点止步于 6 月下旬和 7 月初低点 $495–498 上方。阻力为 $526.7–530，其次 $548（10月20日高点）和 $560（10 日均线）。支撑为 $495–498，其次 $460（7月17日低点）和 $440.5（9月3日低点）。若收盘重回 $530 上方，下一目标看 $548；若收盘跌破 $495，将打开 $460。
